correctness.rationale: For each one-per-square independent uniform sample, Var(Q_n)=n^-4 sum of Bernoulli cell variances. With m=floor(nc), theta={nc}, cells contributing have ai+bj=m-k for 0<=k<a+b; c<a and a<=b ensure every nonnegative solution fits the n by n grid. The piecewise triangular/trapezoid CDF of aU+bV yields W(theta)=(-a^4+5a^3b+10ab^3+1)/(60ab^2)-theta^2(1-theta)^2/(2ab^2) by finite power sums. Primitive counting N_{a,b}(s)=s/(ab)+O_{a,b}(1) gives n^3Var=cW(theta)/(ab)+O(1/n). Irrational Kronecker/density and rational residue cycling yield the asserted exact cluster sets, including sharp diagonal [7c/32,c/4]. Independent fraction calculations corroborated 77 distinct W and finite n cell-count identities; only the analytic lattice-count and exact power sums prove all n.
residual_risks: Direct finite arithmetic checks are corroborative and do not prove the irrational phase claim. The formula assumes fixed primitive integer normal and c in (0,a), not general lines intersecting other square boundaries.
